title: Block 4: Refactor the Worker engine into a blind, independent sub-age
description: Refactor the Worker engine into a blind, independent sub-agent spawner (e.g., ComponentFocuser, ColorSpecialist). [Acceptance Criteria: Workers execute single atomic nodes with conceptual "80% negative space" (receiving zero unnecessary global context) and enforce pure vertical integration by strictly forbidding lateral communication between sibling agents.]
